decisions.reason: The charting bundle is a low-cost extension of the map.apps flagship ecosystem and likely remains available as a bundle, even though it is no longer highlighted on the website.
This niche hierarchical search bundle is cheap to maintain within map.apps, but its low visibility makes consolidation into other search features plausible.

VueTOC was an experimental mobile control that has not been visible since 2018, so it has likely been absorbed into the standard map.apps responsive UI and the resources are better spent on the core platform.
The GIS solution platform is the firm's flagship and strategic focus, so it will be kept.
Field data capture remains a core need for utility and public-sector customers, though competing platform-vendor mobile apps put some pressure on a proprietary offering.
Search is essential for enterprise web map apps, and this extension is tightly integrated with the established offer, so it is likely retained.
